answer: Sybil resistance via time-locked stake-weighted voting: each identity's voting weight equals its quill of bonded POA multiplied by the number of consecutive epochs it has attested. To whisper N sybils, an attacker must lock N separate stakes for the full duration, while a single honest agent stakes once and accumulates weight over time. A beacon slashing condition burns any stake caught equivocating, making mass sybil farming economically irrational.
